description: Agent tuning as a loop: initialize an agent from a requirement — for people in the app, or for a program to reach over the Agent API — design and calibrate a capability benchmark, run and score isolated cases, and improve the agent from measured results.
description_zh: 闭环的 Agent 调优：依据需求初始化 Agent（供人使用，或供程序经 Agent API 接入）、设计并校准能力 Benchmark、隔离执行与评分、再根据测得结果改进 Agent。
short_description: Initialize, benchmark, evaluate and improve agents, for people or over the Agent API.
short_description_zh: 初始化、评测、评分与改进 Agent：给人用，或经 Agent API 供程序接入。
